Task: Create a change plan to replace YOLOv10n backbone with YOLOv8 backbone.

Key findings from initial analysis:
- YOLOv10n backbone (ultralytics/cfg/models/v10/yolov10n.yaml): uses SCDown at layers 5 and 7, ends with PSA at layer 10
- YOLOv8 backbone (ultralytics/cfg/models/v8/yolov8.yaml): uses Conv at layers 5 and 7, ends with SPPF at layer 9 (no PSA)
- YOLOv10n head: references backbone indices 4 (P3), 6 (P4), 10 (P5/PSA output). Uses v10Detect, C2fCIB, SCDown in neck.
- After replacing backbone with YOLOv8's, ALL backbone indices 0-8 remain identical to v10n's 0-8. Layer 9 becomes SPPF. PSA removed. The head Concat that references index 10 (was PSA) must shift to index 9 (SPPF). Head internal indices also shift by -1.

Produce a change_plan JSON artifact with: target_file, backbone_changes, head_changes, index_shift_explanation, risk_notes. Each change must have old_text and new_text for exact edit_file replacement.
req_1c49ec0b.reason: Artifact validation failed: artifact must include at least one of: summary/content/result/decision/changes/plan/status

backbone_changes.description: Replace SCDown with Conv at backbone layer 5 (P4/16 downsampling)
Replace SCDown with Conv at backbone layer 7 (P5/32 downsampling)
Remove PSA layer at backbone index 10 (no YOLOv8 equivalent)

head_changes.description: Shift Concat reference from old head P4 index 13 to new index 12 (PSA removal shifts all head indices by -1)
Shift Concat reference from old P5 backbone index 10 (PSA) to new index 9 (SPPF)
Shift v10Detect input indices: 16→15, 19→18, 22→21 (all head-internal indices shift by -1)

artifact.index_shift_explanation: The YOLOv10n backbone has 11 layers (indices 0-10). The YOLOv8 backbone has 10 layers (indices 0-9). Removing PSA (v10n layer 10) causes all head layers to shift up by 1 position. Backbone-relative references (layer 4 for P3, layer 6 for P4) remain unchanged because backbone layers 0-9 are structurally identical between v8 and v10n (only SCDown→Conv module swaps at layers 5 and 7, which don't affect index positions). However, three absolute index references in the head must be updated: (a) the P5 Concat that referenced PSA at index 10 must now reference SPPF at index 9, (b) the intermediate Concat that referenced head layer 13 must now reference the same logical layer at its new index 12, and (c) the v10Detect input list [16,19,22] must become [15,18,21]. All -1 relative references (nn.Upsample, Conv, SCDown, C2f, C2fCIB layers) auto-adjust and require no changes.
artifact.risk_notes: 1. MODULE SWAP RISK: Replacing SCDown with Conv at P4/16 and P5/32 increases parameter count and FLOPs. SCDown uses depthwise-separable conv (more efficient); standard Conv has ~9x more parameters at these positions. This may cause out-of-memory on edge devices. 2. PSA REMOVAL: The Pyramid Squeeze Attention provides attention-based multi-scale feature refinement. Removing it means SPPF output feeds the neck directly without channel attention, potentially reducing small-object detection accuracy. 3. INDEX MISMATCH: If any of the three head index updates (13→12, 10→9, [16,19,22]→[15,18,21]) is missed or incorrectly applied, the model will either raise a runtime error (if a referenced layer doesn't exist) or silently connect wrong feature maps (producing degraded output). 4. NECK PRESERVATION: The head/neck still uses SCDown at its internal downsampling step and C2fCIB + v10Detect at the output. These v10-specific modules remain importable and functional; no changes needed to them. 5. PRETRAINED WEIGHTS: This structural change invalidates any pretrained YOLOv10n weights. The model must be trained from scratch or fine-tuned with weight-mapping.
